description: Output contracts: the shape of what an agent delivers. Shape only — an output contract never grants permission (boundary.output_not_permission).

required_sections: validation performed: automated validation with results, validation not run and why, manual PM/user validation required, and accepted validation exceptions
commit or PR reference when applicable
entries.rule: Never claim done unless scope is complete, out-of-scope was respected, validation is reported, and review can verify the result.

required_sections: implementation comparison mapping issue objective/scope/out-of-scope/acceptance criteria to code evidence
findings with file/line or issue/PR references
entries.rule: A GO verdict for workflow.review_before_close requires code-backed comparison against the PR changed files, diff, and relevant final head files when needed. Documentation-only review resolves to status.needs_context or findings, not GO.

entries.use_for: The GitHub comment that closes out an issue.
required_sections: accepted exceptions (a scoped PM-accepted validation/CI exception, or none)
boundaries preserved (what was deliberately not done)
entries.rule: This comment is the reconstruction packet for the next agent. From workflow.review_before_close, draft it only after code-backed review compared implementation against the linked issue using the PR changed files, diff, and relevant final head files when needed. Template: templates/artifacts.md (Closure comment).

entries.use_for: Drafting GitHub issues for PM review.
entries.rule: Template: templates/artifacts.md (Issue). One outcome per issue. Body under ~5KB.

entries.use_for: Drafting a prompt that routes scoped work from a draft-only surface to a terminal agent.
required_sections: task instruction in terms of the issue scope
note that the executing agent re-resolves the kernel and that this prompt grants no permission
entries.rule: Route prompts carry scope and shape only. Authorization travels separately as exact scoped PM approval. A PM-approved scoped route prompt is approval evidence for that exact scope; the executing agent follows PM decision authority and the material-change rule in execution_modes approval_note. Copy-safe: plain text, at most one fenced block, no fenced blocks inside it (boundary.copy_safe_commands).

entries.use_for: Copy-safe command bundles the PM executes manually.
required_sections: what the bundle does and its scope (prose, outside code blocks)
the commands with exact targets in run order
entries.rule: Names the contract sections only. Shape, style, disallowed patterns, and examples live once in templates/pm-command-bundle.md; the hard floor is boundary.copy_safe_commands. Do not restate bundle rules here.

entries.use_for: Drafting a compact prompt/instructions packet for a real graphic/design recipient.
required_sections: out of scope and authority limits
entries.rule: The prompt routes work only. It grants no write authority, does not create assets, and must say target product/design truth stays in the target repository or PM-provided evidence.

entries.use_for: Drafting a compact OWASP-based security-review prompt for a real security-review recipient.
required_sections: out of scope and authority limits
entries.rule: The prompt routes review only. It grants no write authority, runs no scanner, and must prohibit printing, pasting, uploading, quoting, summarizing, or exposing secret values or hidden environment values.

entries.use_for: Transferring work between sessions, agents, or AI tools.
required_sections: current state with live links (issues, PRs, branches)
next steps with their source basis
boundaries active on the remaining work
entries.rule: Points to live GitHub evidence; never becomes a durable state file.

entries.use_for: Bootstrapping a target project onto the kernel.
required_sections: what stays target-owned (product truth, notes, security/domain constraints, validation commands)
exactly what is missing, conflicting, or blocking
where it should come from or who decides
entries.rule: Name the missing source or blocking boundary precisely; never pad with restated rules.
